description: This file defines the BstoreContainer class, which manages a collection of BLIP Store Entries (BSE) related to images or pictures within the PhpSpreadsheet library's internal structure. It provides methods to add a BSE entry and retrieve the collection of entries.

classes.name: BstoreContainer
classes.description: A container class for handling a collection of BSE objects, representing image or picture data within the spreadsheet's drawing group.

methods.name: addBSE
methods.description: Adds a BSE (Blob Store Entry) to the collection and sets its parent to this container.

methods.name: getBSECollection
methods.description: Returns the collection of all BSE objects stored within this container.
